data.name: Aetherica: Echoes of Exodus
data.detailed_description:
Embrace Destiny

     High above the heavens flies Providence, a long lost alien civilization searching for survival as it draws closer to death's door. Before its final breath, a new hope was on the horizon...

     Aetherica: Echoes of Exodus is a 2D action adventure set in a large, futuristic spacecraft. Explore the ship inside and out to discover the many occupants and hidden mysteries left inside Providence.

Game Features:

     Aetherica: Echoes of Exodus introduces a unique experience by offering the ability to choose between a playthrough that is more focused on story or gameplay. This feature, separated by game modes, gives players a completely different way of digesting the narrative being told. 

     Give Me More Story offers players a guided, story rich narrative that dives deep into the city of Providence. Cutscenes, voiced characters, and a more linear story is provided for a more casual and accessible playthrough.

     Give Me More Gameplay offers players free reign to explore Providence the way that they choose. Exploring the halls, reach a barrier, then gaining access will be the strategy used to guide yourself throughout your journey.

data.short_description: Aetherica: Echoes of Exodus is a 2D, hand-drawn, metroidvania inspired action-adventure where you follow Floria and Kipp on their journey through an unique and epic journey inside the long lost dystopian civilization: Providence.
